newsitem.title: china: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - March 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - March 4.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
- An objective, comprehensive and correct understanding of difficulties faced by state-owned enterprises should be developed so they can be tackled effectively, President Jiang Zemin says
- Premier Li Peng says rejuvenation of state-owned enterprises is of great significance in consolidating the socialist system

- Politburo member Li Ruihuan says literary and art workers should take Deng Xiaoping's concepts on literature and art as the guideline, and make concerted efforts to promote the prosperity of arts and literature.
- Politburo member Hu Jintao says the great banner of Deng Xiaoping's theory of building socialism with Chinese characteristics must be held high and the Party's line and principles upheld.
- State Development Bank loans $100 million to Dqing ethylene project
- China's metallurgical industry makes pre-tax profits of 22.1 billion yuan in 1996
- Minister of Construction Hou Jie says to abolish welfare system in housing distribution
- China to reform grain circulation system in 1997, with firms independent of government and to pay for storage
- China starts shipping 3 million tonnes of corn to south from March 1
- Top legislator Qiao Shi calls for continued efforts to reinforce the role of agriculture in national economy and to reform township enterprises to adapt to market
- Developments in international and domestic situations have put Hong Kong's return to the motherland beyond doubt, says Zhou Nan, director of the Xinhua News Agency Hong Kong Branch.
- $3.6 billion for special state fund for mergers and bankcruptcies of state firms
